_note: Searches for the Research & Innovation section (scripts/research.mjs). Each query is sent to Europe PMC (which includes all of PubMed and the medRxiv/bioRxiv preprints) and, when NCBI_EMAIL is set, to PubMed directly. A date range is added to every query. Papers must still mention drug safety or PV to be kept.

queries.name: AI and NLP in PV
queries.europepmc: (pharmacovigilance OR "drug safety" OR "adverse drug reaction" OR "adverse drug event" OR "safety signal") AND ("natural language processing" OR "machine learning" OR "deep learning" OR "artificial intelligence" OR "large language model" OR "text mining" OR automation)
queries.pubmed: (pharmacovigilance[tiab] OR "drug safety"[tiab] OR "adverse drug reaction*"[tiab] OR "adverse drug event*"[tiab]) AND ("natural language processing"[tiab] OR "machine learning"[tiab] OR "deep learning"[tiab] OR "artificial intelligence"[tiab] OR "large language model*"[tiab] OR "text mining"[tiab] OR automat*[tiab])

queries.name: Case processing and literature
queries.europepmc: pharmacovigilance AND ("case processing" OR "individual case safety report" OR ICSR OR "literature screening" OR "literature monitoring" OR "duplicate detection" OR deduplication OR MedDRA OR "case narrative")
queries.pubmed: pharmacovigilance[tiab] AND ("case processing"[tiab] OR "individual case safety report*"[tiab] OR ICSR*[tiab] OR "literature screening"[tiab] OR "literature monitoring"[tiab] OR duplicate*[tiab] OR MedDRA[tiab] OR narrative*[tiab])

queries.name: Signal detection methods
queries.europepmc: TITLE:("signal detection" OR "signal management" OR "signal assessment" OR "signal prioritization" OR "signal prioritisation")
queries.pubmed: ("signal detection"[ti] OR "signal management"[ti] OR "signal assessment"[ti] OR "signal prioriti*"[ti])

queries.name: Real-world safety evidence methods
queries.europepmc: (pharmacovigilance OR "drug safety") AND ("real-world data" OR "electronic health record" OR "claims data" OR "target trial" OR "causal inference" OR "active surveillance" OR "Sentinel System")
queries.pubmed: (pharmacovigilance[tiab] OR "drug safety"[tiab]) AND ("real-world data"[tiab] OR "electronic health record*"[tiab] OR "claims data"[tiab] OR "target trial"[tiab] OR "causal inference"[tiab] OR "active surveillance"[tiab])

queries.name: Patients, systems and regulatory intelligence
queries.europepmc: pharmacovigilance AND ("patient reporting" OR "social media" OR E2B OR IDMP OR interoperability OR "regulatory intelligence" OR "knowledge graph" OR "federated")
queries.pubmed: pharmacovigilance[tiab] AND ("patient report*"[tiab] OR "social media"[tiab] OR E2B[tiab] OR IDMP[tiab] OR interoperab*[tiab] OR "regulatory intelligence"[tiab] OR "knowledge graph*"[tiab] OR federated[tiab])

queries.name: Aggregate reporting automation
queries.europepmc: (PSUR OR PBRER OR DSUR OR "periodic safety update report" OR "aggregate safety report") AND (automation OR "natural language" OR "language model" OR "machine learning")
queries.pubmed: (PSUR*[tiab] OR PBRER*[tiab] OR DSUR*[tiab] OR "periodic safety update report*"[tiab] OR "aggregate report*"[tiab]) AND (automat*[tiab] OR "natural language"[tiab] OR "language model*"[tiab] OR "machine learning"[tiab])
